newsitem.title: USA: Clorox gets U.S. ok to market fipronil. [CORRECTED 17:47 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Clorox gets U.S. ok to market fipronil. [CORRECTED 17:47 GMT]

text.p: Clorox Co said it received U.S. regulatory approval to market the insecticide fipronil, developed by Rhone-Poulenc Agro.

Clorox has been licensed by Rhone-Poulenc to market fipronil in the U.S. in its products Combat(R) and Maxforce(R) which are sold for consumer and professional uses, respectively. (Corrects to specify in which products fipronil will be marketed).
Fipronil belongs to a new class of insecticides which provide long-lasting control of pests at extremely small doses, Clorox said.
